# RVL-CDIP-Classifier {.page-title}

[Computer vision & prompt engineering]{.kicker}

## Overview

A toolkit for testing how well general-purpose vision models can sort scanned documents, built so prompts and models can be compared on evidence instead of impressions.

## What I built

- A Python toolkit that converts TIFF/PDF pages to 300-DPI images, runs OCR, and sorts documents into the 16 RVL-CDIP categories using OpenRouter vision models.
- More than 17 prompt iterations, each evaluated the same way.
- Confusion matrices, misclassification analyses, and cost projections used to choose prompts and models.
